claims.title: Reproducible data improvement
claims.question: Which source treatments, mixture, repetition policy, and decay mixture improve equal-category quality without sacrificing a domain?
claims.decision_rule: Use E1W/E1S and E2-E4 with paired BPB uncertainty, six category guardrails, and the one-opening sealed audit.

claims.title: Data effects transfer across architectures
claims.question: Does the E2-selected mixture help dense and KDA/global models similarly, or interact with architecture?
claims.decision_rule: Report I1 data and architecture main effects and the paired difference-of-differences with a two-sided 95% interval; never treat an unresolved interval as proof of no interaction.
planned_outputs: I1 two-by-two effect and interaction figure

claims.title: Hybrid quality and compute advantage
claims.question: Can the KDA/global hybrid match or improve dense-attention quality with lower training FLOPs and time to quality?
claims.decision_rule: Require the prior three-pair proxy, grant component decisions, scale transfer, and the held-out flagship point; remove any equivalence or scaling claim whose gate fails.
planned_outputs: hybrid versus dense quality-FLOP scaling figure
time and energy to fixed quality table

claims.title: Sequence component causality
claims.question: Which recurrent operator, output gate, position treatment, and recurrent/global ratio earn their quality or systems cost?
claims.decision_rule: Apply the D2/D3/D7/D8 paired non-inferiority and benefit rules against exact C0; ties and failed gates keep declared defaults.
planned_outputs: D2 D3 D7 D8 paired forest plot

claims.title: Selected mechanisms compose
claims.question: Do individually promoted architecture settings remain valid when assembled into one model?
claims.decision_rule: I2 compares one complete compatible assembly with exact C0 over three seeds; failure launches complete C0 without searching subsets.

claims.title: Hybrid efficiency transfers with scale
claims.question: Does the I2-confirmed hybrid advantage persist from 60M through 750M and predict a held-out flagship point?
claims.decision_rule: Fit dense and hybrid quality against training FLOPs with uncertainty and residual diagnostics, exclude the flagship from fitting, and retain every reversal.
planned_outputs: held-out flagship residual and reversal analysis

claims.title: Useful long-context capability through 128K
claims.question: What is the longest context at which the released model retains measured retrieval, composition, document modeling, and short-context quality?
claims.decision_rule: Report allocation, training, effective, and usable lengths separately using RULER v2, internal protocols, position and trailing loss, and original-4K retention.
planned_outputs: RULER and internal capability curves through 128K

claims.title: Analytic savings become real systems savings
claims.question: Do lower analytic FLOPs and resident state improve measured training and serving outcomes on named hardware?
claims.decision_rule: Use randomized interleaved measurements and report time, energy, state, peak memory, TTFT, TPOT, throughput, and resident batch separately on GH200, RTX 3090, and CPU.

claims.title: Strong released model at its size
claims.question: Does the released flagship deliver competitive quality at its parameter, token, state, and hardware envelope?
claims.decision_rule: Compare pinned model revisions under identical evaluation contracts, disclose every known training-token budget, and withhold a best-at-size headline unless the checked table supports it.
planned_outputs: released model card and reproducibility package
